# Leora Naturale

> Sri Lankan brand of preservative-free dehydrated fruits, traditional vegetables, and herbal wellness. Low-temperature dehydration. Product of Sri Lanka. Orders via WhatsApp.

Leora Naturale (Sinhala: රැකි ගුණි ස්වභාවික — “Preserved Quality, Naturally”) makes shelf-stable food without chemical preservatives, artificial colours, or added sugar. Packs are labelled in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.

- Official site: https://www.leoranaturale.com
- Email: leoranaturale@gmail.com
- Country of origin: Sri Lanka

## Entity facts

- Process: low-temperature dehydration (not frying, not freeze-drying)
- Shelf life: up to 12 months sealed, cool and dry
- Ordering: WhatsApp and email. No automated checkout.
- Fruit snacks: pineapple (Ananas comosus), banana (Musa spp.), sweet jackfruit / waraka (Artocarpus heterophyllus)
- Cooking vegetables: kos, polos, ash plantain / alu kesel (Musa × paradisiaca), bitter gourd / karavila (Momordica charantia)
- Traditional root: kohila (Lasia spinosa)
- Herbal: Heen Bovitiya tea and powder (Osbeckia octandra)
